name: sheen-sweep
title: Sheen sweep
description: A diagonal light streak sweeps across a button or card on hover.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DzButton } from '@dzup-ui/core'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useReducedMotion } from '../motion'

const reduced = useReducedMotion()
const sheen = computed(() => ({
  'dz-sheen': true,
  'dz-sheen--reduced': reduced.value,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <DzButton variant="solid" tone="primary" :class="sheen">Get started</DzButton>
</template>
